Entry.JapaneseText: <Dio>
Entry.EnglishText: <Dio>

Entry.JapaneseText: <Arche>
Entry.EnglishText: <Arche>

Entry.JapaneseText: <Chester>
Entry.EnglishText: <Chester>

Entry.JapaneseText: <Mel>
Entry.EnglishText: <Mel>

Entry.JapaneseText: <Arche>＆<Chester>
Entry.EnglishText: <Arche> & <Chester>

Entry.JapaneseText: よっしゃー勝ったぜ
Entry.EnglishText: Hell yeah, we won!

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔物をポイポイっと、 今回も楽勝、楽勝～
Entry.EnglishText: Smack 'em around, and what'll it be? That's another...victory!

Entry.JapaneseText: 何が楽勝だ。 こっちは走り回って疲れてるってのに
Entry.EnglishText: What's there to be happy about? Every fight, I have to run here, then run there. It's exhausting.

Entry.JapaneseText: 後ろを守ってる<Chester>は <Dio>より走ってないじゃん
Entry.EnglishText: But you're always in the back, <Chester>. <Dio>'s running a lot more than you!

Entry.JapaneseText: 程度の問題じゃねぇ。ホウキにまたがって 飛んでるだけのおまえとは違うんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: That's not the point. But you don't get it, since you sit up there on your broom the whole time.

Entry.JapaneseText: 何言ってんのよ！ ホウキで飛ぶのってすっごい難しいんだから
Entry.EnglishText: What're you even talking about!? Flying on a broom is pretty hard, too, you know!

Entry.JapaneseText: この、あ・た・し∀だから上手に飛べるんだからね
Entry.EnglishText: It's only the great <Arche> that can make it look easy!

Entry.JapaneseText: ホウキの機嫌を損ねないように、やさしーく 乗ってあげるってわけ。わかったかなぁ？
Entry.EnglishText: 'Cause I'm so nice and kind that the broom wants to have me riding it! You understand, don't you?

Entry.JapaneseText: そんなんわかんねぇよ
Entry.EnglishText: Nope. I haven't got a clue what you're talking about.

Entry.JapaneseText: なんだってー！
Entry.EnglishText: Why, you...!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Arche>さんと<Chester>さんって仲いいね
Entry.EnglishText: <Arche> and <Chester> are so close!

Entry.JapaneseText: オレ、仲いいように見えねけど……
Entry.EnglishText: Huh... Doesn't seem that way to me...

Entry.JapaneseText: <Dio>ってば気づかないの？ ……お子ちゃま
Entry.EnglishText: Really, <Dio>? ...You're still just a kid, I guess.

Entry.JapaneseText: もっとお子ちゃまの<Mel>に言われたくねー
Entry.EnglishText: I don't wanna hear that from a little girl like you, <Mel>!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Dio>なんて、お子ちゃまのお子ちゃまでしょ
Entry.EnglishText: Most of the toddlers at day-care are more mature than you, <Dio>!

Entry.JapaneseText: へへぇ∀ あの子たち仲いーね ははは、あいつら仲いいな
Entry.EnglishText: Hehe, those kids get along so well! Hah, those two make a great pair.

Entry.JapaneseText: イーだ けっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Ew! Ugh!
